FALSE-FRIEND ALERT   Contrôlable, القابلة للضبط
The IMA Arabic glossary says تكلفة قابلة للضبط; Arab textbooks usually say التكلفة القابلة للرقابة. French 'contrôlable' here means 'that a manager can influence', not 'that an auditor can check'.

EXAM TRAP   Slack is measured from the evidence
Slack is the evidence-based figure minus the padded figure. Measuring it against the manager's own proposal, or as a share of the proposal, gives the wrong answer.
